title: Guide page template redesign: Markdown renderer, hero image, quick-answer extraction, FAQ accordion, and three conversion zones
description: Rewrite the guide page template (src/app/(public)/guides/[slug]/page.tsx) to: render libraryBody as styled Markdown via react-markdown + remark-gfm, show hero image, extract Quick Answer 3-card block and FAQ accordion from Markdown at render time, implement GuideSoftToolCta (Zone A), GuideMidPageCta (Zone B), and the closing CTA band (Zone C) with funnel-aware copy and TrackedCtaLink events. Install react-markdown and remark-gfm. Implement markdown-utils.ts with extractQuickAnswer and extractFaqs + unit tests. Validation source of truth: testplan.md T01–T16, B01–B05.
